structure: Part 7, Import reason: the 21 traces of import-reason.fit.spec.js (describe 'import-reason feature' 6 tests, 'import-reason reveals' 10 tests, 'import-reason reveal accessibility' 5 tests), every one mined, plus the spec file for test titles and assertions. The playwright trace viewer tim installs refused these zips (TraceVersionError: trace created by a newer Playwright), so each zip, already unpacked in this part's working folder as r01..r21 in the partition's read order (checked against each trace's own title), was mined with jq straight from its 1-trace.trace (before/after action events and DOM frame snapshots) and 1-trace.network (requests, POST bodies, redirects). Refs name a trace by the five-hex hash in its folder name (traces-animals-fit/import-reason-import-reaso-<hash>-.../trace.zip) and its spec line, plus a call id. Every test reaches the page the same way: stub sign-in, start a notification at /live-animals, answer the origin page (France, No), then go straight to /live-animals/notifications/<ref>/import-reason. One page is in scope: 'Main reason for import' (caption 'About the consignment'), one visually hidden-legend radio group of five reasons, four of which open a conditional reveal: Internal market (purpose radios, 11 options), Transhipment or onward travel (destination country), Transit (port of exit, then destination country) and Temporary admission horses (exit date with an MOJ date picker, then port of exit); Re-entry opens none. States mined: first load (d35ea call@3215), reveals opened (9686e, a4fda, 5a9a5, 0d9f5, 37935), picker dialog open (31ec8, 5d7fa), error states (53e8f invalid reason, 71671 transit country missing, 92eb2 and 6c14b purpose missing, 637ba exit date missing, 4b0a1 date and port missing, ce728 port and country missing), save-and-revisit (5dffd, c6c14, 31ec8), back link (aa44e), and axe runs (e8003, 4b0a1, ce728, 0c220, 6c14b, 5d7fa). After a valid save the page redirects to the notification hub ('Overview'), whose task list was read once (5dffd call@3837) for this task's row. Nothing on the page is conditional except the reveals and the error state.
